testCase:
R-43: Find cats available for adoption within 10 miles of zip code 94587, Young or adult-age cats, sorted by Oldest Addition.
Goal: Find cats available for adoption within 10 miles of zip code 94587, Young or adult-age cats, sorted by Oldest Addition.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/r-43/
STEP 2: Click "Only necessary"
STEP 3: Click "Cats"
STEP 4: Fill "Location (zip)" with "94587"
STEP 5: Select "10 miles" in "Distance"
STEP 6: Check "Young"
STEP 7: Check "Adult"
STEP 8: Select "Oldest Addition" in "Sort by"
STEP 9: Click "Search"
STEP 10: Verify "Showing: Cats within 10 miles of 94587, Young and Adult, Oldest Addition (5 results, first: Tigger)" is visible
